subject.title: [Feature]: Support Excel (.xlsx/.xls) and generic binary uploads in gateway / input_file

question: Should `/v1/responses` `input_file` grow a core binary workspace-receipt contract for Excel and generic binary payloads, or should that endpoint remain limited to text/PDF extraction until related provider-native and parser work is settled?
rationale: Current code has configurable MIME limits but the implementation decodes allowed non-PDF files into prompt text; arbitrary binary support changes public API behavior, storage, redaction, URL-fetch, and tool-access boundaries.

options.title: Design core binary receipts first
options.body: Add the feature only after maintainers define the durable artifact, metadata, security, redaction, and tool-access contract for Gateway `input_file`.

options.title: Limit this to documented unsupported errors
options.body: Keep Excel and generic binary MIME types unsupported for now, but improve errors/docs so users are not left with silent drops or confusing behavior.

options.title: Defer to adjacent document-input work
options.body: Pause this issue until provider-native document forwarding and read-tool binary handling establish a broader file/document abstraction.

recommendation.title: Design core binary receipts first
recommendation.body: Add the feature only after maintainers define the durable artifact, metadata, security, redaction, and tool-access contract for Gateway `input_file`.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on the OpenResponses input handling and media input limit surfaces where the product contract would land.
